settings.title: Dashboards and traces
settings.intro: Links from the details of workloads, pods, nodes and namespaces and from the traffic graph to your Grafana dashboards and traces. A link opens in your browser; Sextant itself never requests these addresses.
settings.grafanaUrlHint: For example https://grafana.example.com or https://example.com/grafana. Plain http is accepted only for localhost (a port forward).
settings.tracesUrlHint: Grafana with Tempo, or the Jaeger UI. When empty, the Grafana URL is used.
settings.templateHint: A path under the URL above (/d/…) or a full address on the same site. Write a literal brace as %7B or %7D. {from} and {to} are the hour before the click, in milliseconds; {kind} is the kind in lower case (deployment). An empty template gives no link.

presets.lokiPod: Pod logs in Grafana Explore (Loki data source with uid loki)
presets.tempo: Tempo in Grafana Explore (data source with uid tempo)

baseError.tooLong: The URL is too long (at most 2048 characters).
baseError.invalid: This is not a valid URL.
baseError.scheme: Use https; plain http is accepted only for localhost.
baseError.credentials: The URL must not contain a user name or password.
baseError.query: The base URL must not contain ? or #.

templateError.tooLong: The template is too long (at most 2048 characters).
templateError.invalid: The template contains spaces, control characters or a backslash.
templateError.brace: A brace that is not a variable: write a literal brace as %7B or %7D.
templateError.variable: The template uses a variable this link does not have.
templateError.origin: The template must stay on the site of the base URL.
